$comment: Which DeepSeek Harness build the desktop shell wraps.
npm    - npm install the published @deepseek-ai/dsh at 'npm.version' (fast, no toolchain)
source - pnpm build + pnpm deploy this repository checkout (picks up local harness edits)
'source.repoRoot' is relative to desktop/. '..' is this fork's checkout.
'node.range' picks the Node.js major bundled next to the harness; the exact
patch release is resolved at build time and recorded in runtime/manifest.json.
